newsitem.title: JAPAN: Monetary policy aims at price stability -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Monetary policy aims at price stability -- BOJ.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's (BOJ) monetary policy will put emphasis on stabilising domestic prices, rather than stability of the foreign exchange market, BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary committee on Friday.

"If we include stability of the currency market as a goal in our monetary policy, it may undermine the stability of domestic prices. From this point of view, the (MOF) advisory panel on the financial system designated price stability as the basic criterion (for monetary policy)," he said.
Matsushita also said that since land and stock prices have a strong impact on overall prices, the BOJ would take these into consideration when making its policy decisions.
